evidence.detail: R180 SwingUtil rs/gui/M constructs rs/gui/N only inside its TrayIcon factory and immediately attaches it with TrayIcon.addMouseListener; no other exact-v308 class constructs the listener.

mouseClicked restores the owned Frame by setVisible(true) and setState(Frame.NORMAL); on the macOS branch, when the frame is not focused it first hides the frame and invokes the macOS foreground helper before restoring visibility.

Historical RuneLite-derived SwingUtil.java at Jire/tarnish commit a4796be8e8cdef2398faf1081fa6a4da8a0190b1 contains an anonymous MouseAdapter inside createTrayIcon with the same macOS focus workaround and frame restore sequence.

candidates.note: Descriptive name for the anonymous tray-icon MouseAdapter nested behavior recovered from the exact historical SwingUtil source; no standalone original source class name existed.
